+def quota_solver(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    jobs = [j for j in jobs if j["id"] not in blocked]
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_ids = None
+    best_value = None
+    for subset in combinations(jobs, k):
+        ids = {j["id"] for j in subset}
+        if not mandatory <= ids:
+            continue
+        counts = Counter(j["group"] for j in subset)
+        if any(not lo <= counts.get(g, 0) <= hi
+               for g, (lo, hi) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        timeline = []
+        for j in subset:
+            timeline.append((j["start"], 1))
+            timeline.append((j["end"], -1))
+        # At equal times, process ends before starts (half-open intervals).
+        active = 0
+        good = True
+        for _, delta in sorted(timeline, key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1])):
+            active += delta
+            if active > 2:
+                good = False
+                break
+        if not good:
+            continue
+        ordered = tuple(sorted(j["id"] for j in subset))
+        value = sum(j["value"] for j in subset)
+        if best_value is None or value > best_value or (value == best_value and ordered < best_ids):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, ordered
+    if best_ids is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
